integrity: Complete combinatorial proof and two locally executable verification programs; finite checks do not replace the all-length proof; no independent mathematical validation claimed.
limitations: No claim for other forbidden words, cyclic avoidance, Abelian borders, or maximum cross-bifix-free code cardinality. Novelty is subject to unavailable and unindexed earlier work.
scientific_scope: Unbordered linear binary strings avoiding adjacent 11, refined by length and Hamming weight. Exact formal-series equation and positive limiting frequency among admissible strings.
title: A weight-refined border-free spectrum for Fibonacci-admissible binary words
